activity.role: President of Council of Ministers (French Third Republic)
activity.notes: Legally appointed Council President 16 June 1940 under Third Republic; July 10 Assembly constitutional full-powers vote is not the same as July 11 Vichy constitutional acts. This ends the pre-Vichy republican government phase; juridically continuous French Republic Polity is distinct from de facto Vichy governing regime. Activity domain emphasis: governance.

sources.title: French National Assembly — 10 July 1940 constitutional vote
sources.citation_text: Assembly documents Pétain succeeding Reynaud as president of council on 16 June, July 10 full constitutional powers vote and July 11 implementation distinct.
